notes: Fixed: opening a saved character's profile and tapping Edit looked like it did nothing — the button pressed, but no screen appeared. The new Profiles row's own back button reused the id "prof-back", already used by the character profile screen's back button; ids must be unique, so whichever wiring ran later silently took over the wrong button, leaving the profile screen's own back button broken. Once that screen couldn't close itself, it stayed sitting on top of whatever opened next — including the edit screen Edit does open, just hidden underneath. Gave the Profiles panel's back button its own id.
